```{r}
#Making the first plot 
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
CUHB_phenotypes <- read_csv("CUHB_phenotypes.csv")

DON_phenotype_data <- CUHB_phenotypes |> 
  rename( Year = studyYear, accession = germplasmName, DON_concentration = `FHB DON content - ppm|CO_321:0001154`, FHB_index = `FHB disease index - %|CO_321:0501030`, FHB_incidence = `FHB incidence - %|CO_321:0001149`, FHB_severity = `FHB severity - %|CO_321:0001440`) |> 
  select(c(Year, DON_concentration)) |>
  na.omit() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.character(Year), y = DON_concentration)) +
  geom_violin()

DON_phenotype_data

CUHB_cleaned <- 
  CUHB_phenotypes |> 
  rename( Year = studyYear, accession = germplasmName, DON_concentration = `FHB DON content - ppm|CO_321:0001154`, FHB_index = `FHB disease index - %|CO_321:0501030`, FHB_incidence = `FHB incidence - %|CO_321:0001149`, FHB_severity = `FHB severity - %|CO_321:0001440`) 


CUHB_cleaned |> 
  select(c(DON_concentration, FHB_index, FHB_incidence, FHB_severity)) |>
summary() |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#Using code that claude gave me

# Publication-style trait distributions (histogram + density + mean line)
# Uses your CUHB_cleaned data frame and column names.
# Requires: ggplot2, patchwork

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ---- EDIT: column name = axis label (check the units!) -------------------
traits <- c(
  "DON_concentration" = "DON concentration (ppm)",
  "FHB_index"         = "FHB index (%)",
  "FHB_incidence"     = "FHB incidence (%)",
  "FHB_severity"      = "FHB severity (%)"
)
fill_col <- "#0072B2"   # colorblind-safe blue
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_trait <- function(df, trait, xlab) {
  df <- df[!is.na(df[[trait]]), ]   # drop NAs for this trait only
  x <- df[[trait]]
  m <- mean(x)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[trait]])) +
    # histogram scaled to density so the curve sits on the same axis
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30,
                   fill = fill_col, alpha = 0.3, colour = "white",
                   linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_density(colour = fill_col, linewidth = 0.8) +
    # mean marked with a dashed line
    geom_vline(xintercept = m, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    # small rug shows individual observations along the axis
    geom_rug(colour = fill_col, alpha = 0.25, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Density") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
}

panels <- Map(function(tr, lab) plot_trait(CUHB_cleaned, tr, lab),
              names(traits), unname(traits))

fig <- wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fig

# Double-column width (~7 in); adjust height to taste
ggsave("fig_trait_distributions.pdf", fig, width = 7, height = 5.5)
ggsave("fig_trait_distributions.png", fig, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# ---- Optional: split by year (swap `year` for your column name) ----------
library(ggridges)   # only needed for the ridgeline version

trait_labels <- c(
  DON_concentration = "DON concentration (ppm)",
  FHB_index         = "FHB index (%)",
  FHB_incidence     = "FHB incidence (%)",
  FHB_severity      = "FHB severity (%)"
)

dat_long <- CUHB_cleaned |>
  select(Year, all_of(names(trait_labels))) |>
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") |>
  drop_na(Year, value) |>   # drops NAs per trait, not whole rows
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = names(trait_labels)),
         Year  = factor(Year))

# Number of observations behind each panel (useful for the legend)
dat_long |> count(trait)

dat_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30,
                 fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.3, colour = "white") +
  geom_density(colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = dat_long |> summarise(m = mean(value), .by = trait),
             aes(xintercept = m), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free", ncol = 2,
             labeller = as_labeller(trait_labels),
             strip.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11))



fig_ridge <- dat_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = Year, fill = Year)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.6, scale = 1.2, linewidth = 0.3,
                      show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2,
             labeller = as_labeller(trait_labels),
             strip.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Year") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("fig_trait_distributions_ridges.png", fig_ridge,
       width = 7, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
